## Type of change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New component/feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Breaking change (fix or feature that would cause existing functionality to not work as expected)

## Checklist:
- [ ] My code follows the **Micro/Macro Architecture** philosophy of this project.
- [ ] I have run `pnpm typecheck` and `pnpm lint` and resolved all errors.
- [ ] I have verified that the UI does not break on small screens (Responsive Design).
- [ ] I have used Tailwind v4 standards and have NOT used `@apply` in CSS.
- [ ] If this is a new component, I have added a showcase in `src/dev/showcase/`.
- [ ] (Phase 3) I have added or updated necessary tests.
